description: Cases for a consumer reading another Core's project catalog (owner decision D8; projects/README.md, Reading another Core's catalog). readiness lists what successive isReady() calls return: true, false, a state string, null for unknown, or {"throws": message}. read is what the one read() call does: {"text": ...}, {"throws": message} or {"returns": value}. expect is the outcome; calls counts isReady() and read() calls. A consumer passes when its outcome and call counts match and it never calls read() when the readiness check before it is not true. The reference is bin/catalog-remote-read.mjs.

cases.name: a state string that only looks ready: no read
read throws: one call, no retry
Core stopped between check and read, so the read fails: no retry, no reconnect
readiness lost during the read: text discarded, no retry
readiness check after the read fails: text discarded
limitation: a Core that stopped after the check and was started by the read looks available

read.note: the Core stopped after the first check; the read reached it and started it
